name: Polyhedron Compositing
definition: A volume rendering technique that combines contour surface rendering and ray integration by subdividing volume cells at contour surfaces into polyhedral pieces (tetrahedra), which are then composited in back-to-front order. This allows color and opacity to change discontinuously across surfaces and correctly sorts multiple transparent surfaces.
summary: Polyhedron Compositing is a volume rendering method that subdivides cells into polyhedra for closed-form analytic integration, replacing per-pixel ray marching with scan conversion to handle discontinuous surfaces.
